title: Grammar: Past-participle agreement in common written accounts
subtitle: B1 · Unit 11: B1 · TCF writing Task 2: recount, comment and support

steps.title: Past-participle agreement in common written accounts
steps.body: When writing about past events, check agreement after the timeline and task are clear. With être, the past participle agrees with the subject: les participantes sont arrivées. With avoir, it normally stays unchanged unless a direct object appears before the verb: j'ai reçu les informations; les informations que j'ai reçues. First identify the direct object and where it appears; do not confuse an indirect object with a direct object. At this level, focus on frequent forms and meaning-changing edits rather than correcting every minor issue before the message is complete.

steps.title: Past-participle agreement in common written accounts
rows: Les bénévoles sont arrivés à l'heure.
Les consignes que j'ai reçues étaient utiles.
The instructions I received were useful.

steps.prompt: Choose the correct form: Les participantes sont ___.
steps.explain: The participle with être agrees with the feminine plural subject.

steps.prompt: Choose the correct form: Les informations que j'ai ___ étaient utiles.
steps.explain: The direct object les informations appears before ai reçu, so the participle agrees.

steps.prompt: Choose the usual form: J'ai ___ les documents hier.
steps.explain: With avoir and the direct object after the verb, there is no agreement here.
